title: Attempting to send multiple files via bluetooth fails, rather than being queued
line: Sending a file over Bluetooth to a device that is still receiving another one now waits for that transfer to finish instead of failing.
explanation: Every Send via Bluetooth runs its own bluedevil-sendfile, which opens a new OBEX session to the device. Phones refuse a second OBEX connection while a file is being sent to them, so a send started during another transfer failed at once with 'OBEX Connect failed with 0x53'. Now the send still tries to connect first; only if the device refuses while an Object Push session to it is open does it show 'Waiting for the current transfer to <device> to finish…' and try again when a session ends (going back to waiting if another queued send got there first).

commits.message:
sendfile: wait for the running transfer to a device before sending more

Sending a file to a device that was still receiving another one failed
with "OBEX Connect failed", since it refuses a second session. Now when
the device refuses while a file is sent to it, the send waits its turn.

BUG: 362146

media.caption: Second file sent while a 20 MB transfer to the phone runs: 'The connection to Pixel Phone has failed: OBEX Connect failed with 0x53'
Same steps with the fix: the second and third sends wait for the running transfer to Pixel Phone
Afterwards the queued files were sent one after another
With a file-browsing (FTP) session to the phone open, a send that the phone accepts starts right away instead of waiting
